Title: OMS Agent for Linux February release now available

Body.Content:
The OMS Agent for Linux February 2019 release is now available. This release contains many stability and reliability improvements.

If you have installed the OMS Agent for Linux by using Azure extensions and have automatic extension updates turned on, this update will be automatically applied over the coming weeks. Otherwise, you can use the latest installer available in the agent GitHub repo.

For more information, see the agent release notes.
